months.query: 我是经营分析师，做跨年抽查。请仅比较2017年12月和2018年2月，不要包含2018年1月，按每月列出全部状态去重订单数和商品销售额（不含运费）。时间按下单时间，金额BRL；订单与商品先按订单汇总，避免重复计数。
months.old_sql: WITH __ask_scope_orders AS (SELECT scope_o."order_id", scope_o."customer_id", scope_o."order_status", scope_o."order_purchase_timestamp", scope_o."order_approved_at", scope_o."order_delivered_carrier_date", scope_o."order_delivered_customer_date", scope_o."order_estimated_delivery_date" FROM olist_orders_dataset AS scope_o WHERE STRFTIME(scope_o.order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y-%m') IN ('2017-12', '2018-01', '2018-02')), __ask_scope_items AS (SELECT scope_i."order_id", scope_i."order_item_id", scope_i."product_id", scope_i."seller_id", scope_i."shipping_limit_date", scope_i."price", scope_i."freight_value" FROM olist_order_items_dataset AS scope_i WHERE scope_i.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM __ask_scope_orders)), items_by_order AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(price) AS item_sales FROM __ask_scope_items AS olist_order_items_dataset GROUP BY order_id) SELECT STRFTIME(o.order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(i.item_sales), 0), 2) AS item_sales FROM __ask_scope_orders AS o LEFT JOIN items_by_order AS i ON o.order_id = i.order_id GROUP BY STRFTIME(o.order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month

exclude.query: 统计2018年8月下单的全部状态订单，排除SP和RJ两个州，按客户州列出去重订单数，订单数降序、同数按州代码升序，返回所有符合的州。
exclude.old_sql: WITH __ask_scope_orders AS (SELECT scope_o."order_id", scope_o."customer_id", scope_o."order_status", scope_o."order_purchase_timestamp", scope_o."order_approved_at", scope_o."order_delivered_carrier_date", scope_o."order_delivered_customer_date", scope_o."order_estimated_delivery_date" FROM olist_orders_dataset AS scope_o WHERE scope_o.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM olist_customers_dataset WHERE customer_state IN ('RJ')) AND STRFTIME(scope_o.order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y-%m') IN ('2018-08')), __ask_scope_olist_customers_dataset AS (SELECT scope_row."customer_id", scope_row."customer_unique_id", scope_row."customer_zip_code_prefix", scope_row."customer_city", scope_row."customer_state" FROM olist_customers_dataset AS scope_row WHERE scope_row.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM __ask_scope_orders)) SELECT c.customer_state, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count FROM __ask_scope_orders AS o JOIN __ask_scope_olist_customers_dataset AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= CAST('2018-08-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < CAST('2018-09-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND c.customer_state <> 'SP' GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY order_count DESC, c.customer_state ASC

exclude_note.query: 我是区域运营。统计2018年8月下单的全部状态订单，排除SP和RJ两个州，按客户州列出去重订单数，订单数降序、同数按州代码升序，返回所有符合的州。请不要把排除条件反向理解为只看SP和RJ。
exclude_note.old_sql: WITH __ask_scope_orders AS (SELECT scope_o."order_id", scope_o."customer_id", scope_o."order_status", scope_o."order_purchase_timestamp", scope_o."order_approved_at", scope_o."order_delivered_carrier_date", scope_o."order_delivered_customer_date", scope_o."order_estimated_delivery_date" FROM olist_orders_dataset AS scope_o WHERE scope_o.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM olist_customers_dataset WHERE customer_state IN ('RJ', 'SP')) AND STRFTIME(scope_o.order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y-%m') IN ('2018-08')), __ask_scope_olist_customers_dataset AS (SELECT scope_row."customer_id", scope_row."customer_unique_id", scope_row."customer_zip_code_prefix", scope_row."customer_city", scope_row."customer_state" FROM olist_customers_dataset AS scope_row WHERE scope_row.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM __ask_scope_orders)) SELECT c.customer_state, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count FROM __ask_scope_orders AS o JOIN __ask_scope_olist_customers_dataset AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= CAST('2018-08-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < CAST('2018-09-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND NOT c.customer_state IN ('SP', 'RJ') GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY order_count DESC, c.customer_state ASC

samples.query: 重新查询2018年8月按下单时间的全部状态去重订单数、商品销售额和配送超时率。订单总数包含所有状态；只有配送超时率分母使用已送达且实际与预计送达时间齐全的订单。请不要让超时率的样本条件缩小订单总数范围。
samples.old_sql: WITH __ask_scope_orders AS (SELECT scope_o."order_id", scope_o."customer_id", scope_o."order_status", scope_o."order_purchase_timestamp", scope_o."order_approved_at", scope_o."order_delivered_carrier_date", scope_o."order_delivered_customer_date", scope_o."order_estimated_delivery_date" FROM olist_orders_dataset AS scope_o WHERE scope_o.order_status IN ('delivered') AND STRFTIME(scope_o.order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y-%m') IN ('2018-08')), __ask_scope_items AS (SELECT scope_i."order_id", scope_i."order_item_id", scope_i."product_id", scope_i."seller_id", scope_i."shipping_limit_date", scope_i."price", scope_i."freight_value" FROM olist_order_items_dataset AS scope_i WHERE scope_i.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM __ask_scope_orders)), o AS (SELECT order_id, order_status, order_delivered_customer_date, order_estimated_delivery_date FROM __ask_scope_orders AS olist_orders_dataset WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= CAST('2018-08-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND order_purchase_timestamp < CAST('2018-09-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)), items AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(price) AS item_sales FROM __ask_scope_items AS olist_order_items_dataset GROUP BY order_id) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(i.item_sales), 0), 2) AS item_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'delivered' AND NOT o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NULL AND NOT o.order_estimated_delivery_date IS NULL THEN o.order_id END) AS delivered_samples, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'delivered' AND NOT o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NULL AND NOT o.order_estimated_delivery_date IS NULL AND CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) > CAST(o.order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE) THEN o.order_id END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'delivered' AND NOT o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NULL AND NOT o.order_estimated_delivery_date IS NULL THEN o.order_id END), 0), 4) AS delivery_late_rate FROM o LEFT JOIN items AS i ON o.order_id = i.order_id

zero.query: 我是经营负责人，核对一个没有订单的月份。查询2016年11月按下单时间的全部状态去重订单数、商品销售额以及配送超时率。请保留0订单和无法计算的比率区别；没有有效已送达样本时比率应为NULL，不能写0%，也不能据此认定采集缺失或经营停摆。
zero.old_sql: WITH __ask_scope_orders AS (SELECT scope_o."order_id", scope_o."customer_id", scope_o."order_status", scope_o."order_purchase_timestamp", scope_o."order_approved_at", scope_o."order_delivered_carrier_date", scope_o."order_delivered_customer_date", scope_o."order_estimated_delivery_date" FROM olist_orders_dataset AS scope_o WHERE scope_o.order_status IN ('delivered') AND STRFTIME(scope_o.order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y-%m') IN ('2016-11')), __ask_scope_items AS (SELECT scope_i."order_id", scope_i."order_item_id", scope_i."product_id", scope_i."seller_id", scope_i."shipping_limit_date", scope_i."price", scope_i."freight_value" FROM olist_order_items_dataset AS scope_i WHERE scope_i.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM __ask_scope_orders)), o AS (SELECT order_id, order_status, order_delivered_customer_date, order_estimated_delivery_date FROM __ask_scope_orders AS olist_orders_dataset WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= CAST('2016-11-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP) AND order_purchase_timestamp < CAST('2016-12-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)), items AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(price) AS item_sales FROM __ask_scope_items AS olist_order_items_dataset GROUP BY order_id) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, COALESCE(SUM(items.item_sales), 0) AS item_sales, CASE WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'delivered' AND NOT o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NULL AND NOT o.order_estimated_delivery_date IS NULL THEN 1 END) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'delivered' AND NOT o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NULL AND NOT o.order_estimated_delivery_date IS NULL AND CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) > CAST(o.order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE) THEN 1 END) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'delivered' AND NOT o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NULL AND NOT o.order_estimated_delivery_date IS NULL THEN 1 END) END AS delivery_late_rate FROM o LEFT JOIN items ON o.order_id = items.order_id

relative.query: 老板明天开会，帮我看上个月销售额是不是下滑了，利润受了多大影响？希望给我一个能直接汇报的结论。
relative.old_sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT strftime(o.order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(i.price) AS item_sales FROM olist_orders_dataset o JOIN olist_order_items_dataset i ON o.order_id = i.order_id GROUP BY 1) SELECT month, ROUND(item_sales, 2) AS item_sales FROM monthly ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 3

cohort.query: 我是会员运营，想看2018年8月买家中老客的占比：以8月下过单的去重买家为分母，其中在8月1日之前曾下过至少一单的买家为老客。全部订单状态，按下单时间；同一个人多单只算一个人。返回8月买家数、老客数和占比，历史查询不能也被限制在8月。
